searchText: "EIP 7732 stands for execution Payload–Block Separation" - is the intention to PR and rename the formal version https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7732 ? I guess I think it would be most unwise to start trying to redefine well accepted acronyms, like ePBS, just before discussions w.r.t inclusion in Glamsterdam. I don't care much about names but the scaling properties of the PR are the primary reasons for adoption. The fact that execution is separated from consensus is the big gain of this PR and it's missed by most when they think about simply enshrining proposer builder separation
